description: This file defines the CandidateActionHistory class in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It provides methods to retrieve candidate action history IDs, both accessible in general and for interviewers, by utilizing constants from the CandidateService and WorkflowStateMachine classes.

classes.name: CandidateActionHistory
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) that provides methods to get accessible candidate action history IDs, and IDs suitable for interviewers, based on predefined status and actions maps.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Returns an array of candidate action history IDs based on the keys of combined status and action maps.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns an array of candidate action history IDs excluding specific offer, decline, hire, and reject actions, intended for interviewer view.
